'''Vahss''' was a bald [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]-affiliated mercy organization [[Grace Command]] during the [[New Sith Wars]]. Vahss fought and was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during an [[Capture of Devil Squadron|ambush]] by [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] crime lord [[Zodoh]]'s forces in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]].

==Biography==
Vahss served in the [[Republic Starfighter Corps/Legends|Republic Starfighter Corps]] corps during the [[Republic Dark Age]] alongside [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jenn Devaad]]. He was part of an ill fated Republic task force dispatched to [[Daalang/Legends|Daalang]] which was captured and enslaved by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] crime lord [[Zodoh]] after the local inhabitants refused to shelter them. For the next five years, he and his comrades served as slaves to Zodoh until they managed to escape.<ref name="SWKE7">[[Knight Errant: Deluge 2|''Knight Errant: Deluge'' 2]]</ref> This small group of survivors became known as [[Devil Squadron]] and would fly [[Fire Lotus-class starfighter|''Fire Lotus''-class starfighters]] for [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Lemayne]]'s [[Grace Command]], a mercy organization devoted to providing relief assistance to Sith-occupied worlds. However, Grace Command was in reality a front for Lemayne's black operations including [[Operation Deluge]] which involved inundating entire populations in Sith territory with the addictive [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Deluge]] as a means of undermining the Sith war effort. By [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], Operation Deluge had succeeded in weakening the Sith's manpower resources at the cost of adversely affecting many civilian populations.<ref name="SWKE8">[[Knight Errant: Deluge 3|''Knight Errant: Deluge'' 3]]</ref>

Vahss participated during the [[Battle of Capital Cay|assault]] on [[Capital Cay]] when [[Devil Squadron]] "liberated" Aquilaris from Daiman and Zodoh's forces. Later, he was present at the spaceport when Jenn and the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]] were distributing food and medical relief supplies to the civilian population. He was critical of his superior officer Jenn's decision to give Kerra Holt a place within their starfighter squadron, commenting that things could get tricky with a Jedi present. Jenn dismissed his concerns and assured him that Kerra would be too preoccupied with her mission to notice anything suspicious about Grace Command. She added that Kerra would be an important asset in the fight against their nemesis Zodoh, who was trying to make inroads into the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]]. Vahss also expressed his desire to get payback from Zodoh for his wrongs.<ref name="SWKE7" />

Finally, Jenn commented that Kerra would never need to know about Operation Deluge if everything went right. However, Kerra's childhood friend [[Joad Kreel]] was eavesdropping on their secret conversation and learnt about Operation Deluge. The following day, Devil Squadron escorted the medical transport ''[[Mother Grace]]'' to a hyperspace jump-point in the [[Aquilaris Minor system/Legends|Aquilaris Minor system]]. They then departed on a mission to fight Lord [[Malakite]]'s forces on [[Heptooine]]. En route, they intercepted Zodoh's [[Intruder-class starfighter|''Intruder''-class starfighter]] which led them into a trap. In the ensuing [[Capture of Devil Squadron|dogfight]], Devil Squadron was trapped between Zodoh's flagship ''[[Voracious]]'' and a fleet of [[Stormdriver]]s, capital ships capable of generating artificial floods and storms.<ref name="SWKE7" />

Following a confrontation between Jenn and Kerra over the intercom, Jenn ordered Vahss to deactivate Kerra's Fire Lotus starfighter [[Devil Seven]] and bring her back in line. However, before he could comply, his starfighter was shot down by one of Zodoh's Infiltrator starfighters. Vahss died in the subsequent explosion. His death spared him captivity, torture and execution at the hands of Zodoh which marked the fate of his fellow comrades with the exception of Jenn.<ref name="SWKE8" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[John Jackson Miller]] had originally named Vahss as "Voss" before changing it due to the name being identical to one of his readers on Facebook.<ref>{{Faraway|url=comics/starwarsknighterrantdeluge/starwarsknighterrantdeluge2|text=Star Wars: Knight Errant – Deluge #2}}</ref>
